notes: «وحدثنيه يحيى بن حبيب» begins a second isnad for the same saying, so it is a second group; the «ح» before «وحدثنا محمد بن بشار» begins the third
«كلهم عن شعبة، بهذا الإسناد» is written for both later groups, so each repeats Shu'ba and ends at the back reference; nothing is inherited (no previous report is supplied)
«قال أحسبه قال في آذانها» is a doubt about wording and is left out; «- وهو القطان -» is not in this text
